headline: Mercor Review: Jobs, Pay & Application Process (2026)
description: Mercor review covering roles, pay ranges, the AI interview process, and community-reported experiences from this AI talent platform.

acceptedAnswer.text: Mercor organizes human intelligence to power the AI economy, connecting domain experts with AI labs and enterprises for frontier research, RLHF data, and AI agent training.
Mercor raised a $100M Series B at a $2B valuation in February 2025, with investors including Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

mainEntity.name: How long is the Mercor AI interview?

acceptedAnswer.text: Approximately 20 minutes, and it can be retaken up to 3 times from your candidate dashboard.

mainEntity.name: Does Mercor use my interview data to train AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mercor states it uses interview data to train internal recommendation models only, and does not use it to train third-party LLMs; interview responses are not sold.

mainEntity.name: How much does Mercor pay for AI training roles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reported figures include roughly $16/hr for entry-level AI Model Specialist roles, about $70/hr for expert contracts, and $70-$200+/hr for engineering roles.
Yes, payments are processed weekly via Stripe Connect.
Your AI interview and profile are reused across multiple opportunities, reducing the need for repetitive screening.
Minimum qualifications typically require undergraduate-level expertise; many projects require years of experience or an advanced degree.

mainEntity.name: Is Mercor available in my country?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mercor accepts international applicants generally, though engineering roles may skew toward US/Canada-facing work.
